title: The cycle's closer names tests as Class.test; done refuses
what: The cycle's close step passes --test as <file>::<Class>.<test> (for example tests/test_precheck.py::TestTypesStep.test_a_running_mypy_is_named_and_the_uncached_ruff_is_not_blamed, and tests/test_registry_fixes.py::SplitRegistry.test_first_command_in_a_git_checkout_leaves_it_clean); relay queue done refuses that form ("does not hold a test named ...") and accepts <file>::<test>. Either done accepts Class.test and Class::test (unittest names), or the closer passes the form done reads; one of them, with a test.
why: Twice on 30 Oct a ready change stopped at "close queue item" and the front closed it by hand; each stop holds a lane until someone notices.
failing_case: 30 Oct: changes setup-registers-a-project-in-relay-s-own and precheck-s-60-s-timeout-names-no-cause-o both ended with stopped_at "close queue item" and the refusal "tests/<file>.py does not hold a test named <Class>.<test>"; `relay queue done ... --test <file>::<test>` closed both by hand.
pass_cases: relay queue done --test tests/x.py::SomeClass.test_y closes when the method exists
the cycle's close step closes a change whose test is a unittest method without the front
